---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region))

attack_counts <- attacks |> count(Country_lower, name = "attack_count")

world_map |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = "Country_lower") |>
  ggplot(aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attack_count)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90", name = "Attacks") +
  labs(title = "Shark attacks by country") +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
attacks |> count(Fatal_clean)
```
